title: EC60092: Antennas And Propagation For Wireless Communication
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC21006 and EC31001Review of the fundamental principals of
propagation and antennas. Frequency bands for mobile radio systems. Propagation
in free space, over reflecting surface. Effects of atmosphere. Ducting and nonstandard refraction. Propagation over irregular terrain, knife edge diffraction
and path loss prediction models. Propagation in built up areas and
microcellular systems. Propagation inside buildings. Characterization of
multipath phenomenon, short term fading. Statistics of fast fading. Wideband
channel characterisation. Basic concepts of antennas. Examples of antennas for
wireless systems.
